data.overview: Pegasus Galaxy is a multiplayer space strategy game. Players manage planets, build constructions, research technologies, produce ships, and engage in fleet combat.
data.resources: There are three resources: Metal (metal), Crystal (crystal), and Eonium (eonium). Resources are produced by miners each tick. Trade rates apply a 30% loss.
data.construction: Constructions are built on your planet. Each construction has levels. Only one construction can be in progress at a time. Builders contribute points each tick.
data.research: Research unlocks new technologies and ship types. Each research has levels. Only one research can be in progress at a time. Researchers contribute points each tick.
data.military: Ships are produced at your planet. Fleets can be launched with missions: attack, defend, transport, or blockade. Fleet travel time depends on distance.
data.scanning: Wave scans reveal information about target planets and require an Amplifier construction (higher levels unlock more scan types) plus eonium. Types: SURFACE_SCAN (coords, population, asteroids), RESOURCE_SCAN (resources, production), FLEET_COMPOSITION_SCAN (docked fleet), MILITARY_SCAN (docked + named + in-transit fleets), NEWS_SCAN (score, value, xp), INFRASTRUCTURE_SCAN (constructions), RESEARCH_SCAN (research levels), DEEP_SCAN (everything), and INCOMING_SCAN (fleets inbound to the target). Cloaked ships are hidden except on the top-tier DEEP_SCAN.
data.alliances: Players can form alliances. Alliance members share scan intelligence and can coordinate attacks. Each alliance has a leader who manages membership.
data.scoring: Score is calculated based on constructions, research, ships, and resources. The leaderboard shows all players ranked by score.
data.ticks: The game advances in ticks. Each tick, resources are mined, constructions/research progress, fleets move, and combat resolves. Tick duration varies.
